tips: Press the big button on the left to spawn a new game.
Short breaks help you remember more. Stand up and stretch!
Every game gives you coins. Spend them wisely.
Not sure what to play? Try a surprise game.
Drink some water. Your brain likes it.
Mistakes are how we learn. Try again!
Play together with friends in a session. It is more fun.
Level up to unlock new pets like me.
Look away from the screen for 20 seconds every now and then.
Ask SMARTA if you do not know how something works.
Teachers can pick a mode that fits the class.
Sleep well tonight. Rested brains learn faster.

Which planet is closest to the Sun?
